tcs.tc_title: the wired AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The individual AUX Cam settings pop-up for the wired camera is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the pop-up and check that "Edit Name" is offered
2. Select "Edit Name"
3. Read the HU display and check that the name can be edited
tcs.expected_result:
1. "Edit Name" is shown in the pop-up
2. "Edit Name" registers the selection
3. A full QWERTY keyboard is displayed for editing the camera name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: the wired AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera
tcs.test_item:
From this pop-up the user can: -Edit the name of the selected camera

(the wired AUX settings popup offers Edit the name of the selected camera)

reasoning: §29.1.2 列舉四項，四列各驗一項（`-129`～`-132`）。控制項之逐字 label 取 §31.1.1 之 `“Edit Name”`（同一控制項於該節具名）。與 `-148`（§31.1.1）之分工：後者之驗證點為**自設定選單按下該鍵**之流程起點，本列為**該項於本彈窗中被提供**；兩列之來源列不同（**R-CAM10**）。
